title: Refactor Slow Query Processor
problem_statement: The slow query processor directly accesses log files without proper error handling or validation.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues.
suggested_approach: Refactor to use a service layer with TypeScript and implement proper error handling.
success_criteria: All file accesses are validated and errors are handled gracefully.

provenance.evidence: Direct file access without error handling.
